    About the author

    Follow authors to get new release updates, plus improved recommendations.

    Tim Swanson

    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Life has been full of adventure for Tim Swanson, with many experiences shaping his life. Tim's early years were spent in Japan, as the son of missionary parents. Tim enjoyed mission life and his parents trained him in Biblical doctrine and Bible study. At twenty, Tim entered into a relationship with God through Jesus Christ. Most of his adult life, Tim and his family have been hosting Bible studies, teaching, and leading in youth ministry. In 2016, Tim and his family began serving as missionaries to youth and families in the Philippines. Tim is a certified public educator and an ordained minister.

    Tim's books are written to help his readers access information quickly and efficiently, with an emphasis on applying knowledge. Many of Tim's Christian Living books have video links embedded, which provide extension content for each chapter. Tim's latest book, Victorious Living, was written after several years of intense spiritual warfare, resulting in a inspired book on how to live victoriously in the Kingdom of Heaven.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.
